name: Default
shortDescription: Web-based localization platform for managing app translations with in-context editing, machine translation and a REST API, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in with the username admin (the login form asks for an email, enter admin) and the password from the TOLGEE_AUTHENTICATION_INITIAL_PASSWORD environment variable, then change it in the account settings. Self-registration is disabled, so further users join through invitations from the admin.
